positions.title: Enlisted
positions.description:
Active part of a team to operate armored equipment and fire control. Assisted in detection and identification. Operated tracked and wheeled vehicles over varied terrain and roadways in formation and marches. Used and responded to oral commands and visual signals. Led, supervised and served as a member of a unit in offensive and defensive operations. Served and assisted on staffs at senior level and higher. 
•	Took initiative to gain skills and knowledge beyond responsibilities, resulting in leadership role and first Achievement Medal. 
•	Received highest score ranking on company level for excellence in leadership, resulting in promotion to Team Leader.

projects.title: Veteran Connect
projects.description:
Technologies
     •	Web App/API: NodeJS, ExpressJS, MongoDB, Socket.IO, Angular, Material Design, JWT Protected routes, Facebook Authentication, Amazon SES, OneSignal Notification. 
     •	Mobile: Ionic 2, Angular 2, OneSignal Notification, iOS and Android.

Veteran Connect is geolocation based event application designed to strengthen and grow veteran communities in local areas. With Veteran Connect, a veteran can create an event of any activity as well as browse events from 5 miles to 75 miles in radius. Veterans attending an event have access to private chat rooms.

Veterans seeking help from their community can send out QRF requests (Quick Reaction Force). This will notify every user within a 50 mile radius that a veteran is in need of some company. For those who seek professional help, they are given direct access to resources designed to help veterans in crisis.
